overview.text: The Smooth Earth Snake is a small, harmless burrowing snake of the eastern half of the United States.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: From Texas and Iowa east to New Jersey and Florida.

habitat.text: Spends most of its time buried in loose soil or leaf litter.

behaviour.text: Gentle and harmless: its mouth is too small to hurt a person. Its only real defence is to make a smelly mess to put predators off.

diet.text: Mostly earthworms and soft-bodied insects and other small invertebrates.

reproduction.text: Gives birth to live young in August, usually fewer than 10. Newborns are only about 6 cm long.
